title: Storms across US disrupt travel and force Thanksgiving parade cancellations
summary_full: The New York governor declares a state of emergency in several parts of the state due to severe weatherHeavy rain, winds, flooding and high tides are hitting the eastern and western US, snarling travel and leading to the cancellations of at least two commercial Thanksgiving parades.On the East Coast, authorities in Philadelphia ordered the city’s Thanksgiving Day parade in Philadelphia off the streets and will be featured as an “alternative TV event”.
